title: HEAR MY CRY O LORD

lines.text: From the end of the earth,
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,
For Thou O Lord hast been
A tower O Lord against the enemy,
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Hear my cry O Lord,
Attend unto my prayer,
From the end of the earth,
Will I cry unto thee,
When my heart is overwhelmed,
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,
that is higher than I.

[Verse 2]
For Thou O Lord hast been
A shelter unto me,
A tower O Lord against the enemy,
When my heart is overwhelmed
Lead me to the rock that is higher than I
that is higher than I.
